text_en: In the days when the judges ruled, there was a famine in the land, and a certain man of Bethlehem in Judah went to live in the country of Moab, he and his wife and two sons.
text_cn: 当民长执政时代，国内发生了饥荒。有个人带了他的妻子和两个儿子，从犹大白冷到摩阿布乡间去侨居。

text_en: The name of the man was Elimelech and the name of his wife Naomi, and the names of his two sons were Mahlon and Chilion; they were Ephrathites from Bethlehem in Judah. They went into the country of Moab and remained there.
text_cn: 这人名叫厄里默肋客，他的妻子名叫纳敖米，他的两个儿子：一个名叫玛赫隆，一个名叫基肋雍，是犹大白冷厄弗辣大人。他们到了摩阿布乡间，就住在那里。

text_en: But Elimelech, the husband of Naomi, died, and she was left with her two sons.
text_cn: 后来纳敖米的丈夫厄里默肋客死了，留下了她和她的两个儿子。

text_en: These took Moabite wives; the name of the one was Orpah and the name of the other Ruth. When they had lived there about ten years,
text_cn: 他们都娶了摩阿布女子为妻：一个名叫敖尔帕，一个名叫卢德；他们在那里大约住了十年。

text_en: both Mahlon and Chilion also died, so that the woman was left without her two sons and her husband.
text_cn: 玛赫隆和基肋雍二人也相继去世，只剩下了那妇人，没有儿子，也没有丈夫。

text_en: Then she started to return with her daughters-in-law from the country of Moab, for she had heard in the country of Moab that the Lord had considered his people and given them food.
text_cn: 于是她便与她的两个儿媳打算从摩阿布乡间起程回家，因为她在摩阿布乡间听说天主垂顾了他的百姓，赐给了他们食粮。

text_en: So she set out from the place where she had been living, she and her two daughters-in-law, and they went on their way to go back to the land of Judah.
text_cn: 当她和她的两个儿媳，要从寄居的地方出发，取道回犹大故乡的时候，

text_en: But Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, “Go back each of you to your mother’s house. May the Lord deal kindly with you, as you have dealt with the dead and with me.
text_cn: 纳敖米就对她的两个儿媳说：“你们去吧！各自回娘家去！愿上主恩待你们，如同你们待了死者和我一样。

text_en: The Lord grant that you may find security, each of you in the house of your husband. ” Then she kissed them, and they wept aloud.
text_cn: 愿上主赐你们在新夫家里，各得安身！”于是就吻了她们；她们便放声大哭，

text_en: They said to her, “No, we will return with you to your people. ”
text_cn: 向她说：“我们要同你回到你的民族中去。”

text_en: But Naomi said, “Turn back, my daughters, why will you go with me? Do I still have sons in my womb that they may become your husbands?
text_cn: 纳敖米回答说：“我的女儿，你们回去吧！为什么要跟我去呢？难道我还能怀妊生子给你们做丈夫吗？

text_en: Turn back, my daughters, go your way, for I am too old to have a husband. Even if I thought there was hope for me, even if I should have a husband tonight and bear sons,
text_cn: 我的女儿啊，你们回去吧！你们走吧！我已老了，不能再嫁人了；如说我尚有希望，今夜能嫁人，也怀妊生子，

text_en: would you then wait until they were grown? Would you then refrain from marrying? No, my daughters, it has been far more bitter for me than for you, because the hand of the Lord has turned against me. ”
text_cn: 你们又岂能等待他们长大，持身不嫁人？我的女儿啊！不要这样，有了你们我反而更苦，因为上主已伸出手来与我作对。”

text_en: Then they wept aloud again. Orpah kissed her mother-in-law, but Ruth clung to her.
text_cn: 她们于是又放声大哭。敖尔帕吻了自己的婆婆，便回自己的家乡去了；卢德对婆母仍依依不舍。

text_en: So she said, “See, your sister-in-law has gone back to her people and to her gods; return after your sister-in-law. ”
text_cn: 纳敖米向她说：“看，你的嫂子已回她民族和她的神那里去了，你也跟你的嫂子回去吧！”

text_en: But Ruth said, “Do not press me to leave you or to turn back from following you! Where you go, I will go; where you lodge, I will lodge; your people shall be my people, and your God my God.
text_cn: 卢德答说：“请你别逼我离开你，而不跟你去。你到哪里去，我也到哪里去；你住在哪里，我也住在哪里；你的民族，就是我的民族；你的天主，就是我的天主；

text_en: Where you die, I will die— there will I be buried. May the Lord do thus and so to me, and more as well, if even death parts me from you! ”
text_cn: 你死在哪里，我也死在哪里，埋在哪里；若不是死使我与你分离，愿上主罚我，重重罚我！”

text_en: When Naomi saw that she was determined to go with her, she said no more to her.
text_cn: 纳敖米见她执意要与自己同去，就不再劝阻她了。

text_en: So the two of them went on until they came to Bethlehem. When they came to Bethlehem, the whole town was stirred because of them; and the women said, “Is this Naomi? ”
text_cn: 于是二人同行，来到了白冷。她们一到了白冷，全城的人都为她们所惊动。妇女们惊问说：“这不是纳敖米吗？”

text_en: She said to them, “Call me no longer Naomi, call me Mara, for the Almighty has dealt bitterly with me.
text_cn: 她向她们说：“你们不要叫我纳敖米，应叫我玛辣，因为全能者待我好苦！

text_en: I went away full, but the Lord has brought me back empty; why call me Naomi when the Lord has dealt harshly with me, and the Almighty has brought calamity upon me? ”
text_cn: 我去时富足，如今上主却使我空空而回。上主责罚了我，全能者降祸于我，你们为什么还叫我纳敖米呢？”

text_en: So Naomi returned together with Ruth the Moabite, her daughter-in-law, who came back with her from the country of Moab. They came to Bethlehem at the beginning of the barley harvest.
text_cn: 纳敖米同她的儿媳摩阿布女子卢德回来了，是从摩阿布乡间回来的。她们来到白冷，正是开始收大麦的时候。
